name: 360° Synchro Spiral to Half Pipe Combo
description: Combination of a Synchro Spiral and Half Pipe Combo

criterias.normal: after a turn – 360° – of Synchro Spiral the pilots connect to a half pipe and exit it towards each other and start another 360° turn to the other direction in Synchro Spiral, after the turn another connection to a Half Pipe

name: Anti-Rythmic SAT
description: Entry by Tumbling, 180° in the first rotation for maximum points + 1 SAT rotation at the end

criterias.normal: rhythm and regularity of the decreasing angle of the axis, flow, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: from Cab Slide: twist during the Infinite turns, must stay twisted until the SAT. Must stay twisted for 1 SAT rotation, can untwist for the exit. From Tumbling: twisted on the entry, must stay twisted until the SAT. Must stay twisted for 1 SAT turn, can untwist for the exit

name: Asymetric SAT
description: entry from, say, spiral or wingover in same direction (old school)

criterias.normal: energy, timing, flow, trajectory (SAT rotation), angle (135° for maximum score), asymmetric dynamic exit (no collapse, no stall)
criterias.twisted: twisted all the way from entry to exit

name: Asymetric Spiral
description: Series of pendulum turns in the same direction each time

criterias.normal: rhythm, flow, trajectory, angle (135° for maximum score\ –\ the higher the better)
criterias.twisted: twisted all the way from entry to exit

name: Bitch Switch
description: Rodeo SAT + connection to Rodeo SAT with pilots replacing each other
minimum: 2 spiral revolutions around the SAT at the same altitude for each pilot

criterias.normal: same as for SAT

name: Bro Hook
description: One pilot flies straight, the other pilot approaches from behind and connects

name: Bro Hook Lateral Wings
description: One pilot flies straight twisted, the other approaches from behind and connects. After the connection both pilots must position their wings in lateral position – inside tip touch
connection: No connection to other Bro Hook manoeuvres

name: Bro Hook Spiral
description: Start as a Bro Hook. After the connection the pilots must dive into a spiral

criterias.twisted: one pilot has to stay twisted from entry until exit

name: Bro Hook Wingovers
description: Wingover but in Bro Hook position. Both pilots must stay connected during the manoeuvre until the gliders stabilise. Series of pendulum turns with change of direction each time
minimum: twice to one side, twice to the other side with 135° angle

criterias.normal: rhythm, flow, trajectory, angle (the higher the better)
criterias.twisted: one pilot has to stay twisted from entry until exit

name: Corkscrew
description: Spin during the entry over the glider into a Helicopter

criterias.normal: energy on entry, timing, flow. Stable entry into the Helicopter
criterias.twisted: twisted during the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the cork
criterias.reverse: immediate transition to a Helicopter in the opposite direction

connection: Forbidden connection to helicopter

name: Cowboy
description: Misty Flip to dive to Helicopter

criterias.normal: misty Flip criteria + forward dive + short SAT move + transition to Helicopter + Helicopter criteria
criterias.twisted: must be twisted during the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the Misty
criterias.reverse: immediate transition to a Helicopter in the opposite direction

connection: Forbidden connection to Helicopter

name: Esfera
description: Rhythmic SAT pulled to the vertical and followed by an Anti-Rhythmic SAT to the other side

criterias.normal: same as for Rythmic SAT and as for Anti-Rythmic SAT
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry. Must stay twisted until going vertical, untwist when vertical and twist again on the other side for the Anti -Rhythmic. Must stay twisted for at least one SAT rotation. Can exit untwisted. The pilot must twist immediately after untwisting. Untwist during 1 rotation and twist again during the next rotation

name: Flat Stall to Infinity Tumbling
description: Full Stall directly connected into an Infinite Tumbling. The Full Stall must not necessarily be high but shall be perfectly straight. The pilot must not take any energy before the stall. It must come from a straight flying scenario, no pitch before the stall

criterias.normal: rhythm, flow, trajectory (no roll movement), tension in the lines and glider, duration, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, untwist after the stall and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling without twist
criterias.full twisted: twisted on the entry, stay twisted after the stall and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling twisted and untwist at exit (not during the turns)
criterias.devil twist stall: twisted on the entry, untwist during the stall and immediately twist to the other direction and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling twisted
criterias.twisted exit: stay twisted during the exit of the Infinity Tumbling
criterias.flip: the pilot performs a flip just after the glider stalled, proceed into the Infinity Tumbling
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)

connection: Forbidden connection to Tumbling or Anti-Rhythmic SAT

name: Fusion
description: Start from Bro Hook Lateral position. Both pilots spin the wings into deep stall with the leading edge facing each other

criterias.normal: maintenance of the shape, flow, entry, duration (min\ 4 sec.), disconnection

name: Fusion Helicopter
description: Start from Fusion position into Helicopter

criterias.normal: maintenance of the shape, flow, entry, minimum 1 rotation, disconnection

name: HeliFly
description: Helicopter to Tail Slide or Deep Stall directly connected into an Infinite Tumbling. The Tail Slide/Deep  Stall must not necessarily be long but shall be entered directly from the exit a Helicopter

criterias.normal: Rhythm, flow, trajectory (no roll movement), tension in the lines and glider, duration, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: Twisted on the entry, untwist by the helicopter  and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling without twist
criterias.twisted exit: stay twisted during the exit of the Infinity Tumbling
criterias.full twisted: Twisted on the entry and stay twisted until the exit of the infinity tumbling
criterias.hardcore entry: Same as full twisted but with change of twist direction in the entry of the mac twist
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)

connection: Forbidden connection to Tumbling or Anti-Rhythmic SAT

name: Helicopter to SAT
description: Helicopter + connection to SAT

criterias.normal: no rotation on entry and exit, direction
criterias.twisted: twist during the helicopter. Must stay twisted during the whole transition, at least 1 turn of SAT twisted. Can untwist on the exit
criterias.reverse: immediate transition to a SAT in the opposite direction

name: Helicopter
description: Perfect spin with open glider and vertical axe of rotation

criterias.normal: maintenance of the shape, stability of rotation axis (vertical), speed of rotation, low sink rate, duration, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: twisting during the helicopter, must stay twisted for 2 turns, can untwist for the exit

name: Infinity Tumbling
description: Series of perfect Tumbling (pitch movement)

criterias.normal: rhythm, flow, trajectory (no roll movement), tension in the lines and glider, duration, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, must stay twisted, untwist at exit and NOT during the turns
criterias.flip: body flip either forward or backwards during the Infinite Tumbling. Flip must begin and end at the same point of one full rotation
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)
criterias.hardcore entry: twisted on the speed taking, getting untwisted and twisted in the other direction while pulling the entry
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn

connection: Forbidden connection to Tumbling or Anti-Rhythmic SAT

name: Joker
description: Tumbling entry. 1 rotation only, stopped during the dive. Exit with high energy connected to a Helicopter to the same side + SAT to Helicopter connection

criterias.normal: energy on entry, timing, flow, energy on exit, angle, connection to Helicopter (fluidity, rapidity). Only 1 Tumbling rotation
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, twisted on the dive, must untwist during the connection into helicopter
criterias.reverse: immediate transition to a Helicopter in the opposite direction.

connection: Forbidden connection to Helicopter

name: Looping
description: Entry from asymmetric spiral or a normal spiral. Reversal of a revolution that makes the pilot turn around the wing in a roll movement

criterias.normal: entry, energy, timing, flow, trajectory (pitch movement), angle (180° for maximum score), exit or connection
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, must stay twisted until the glider stabilises

name: MacFly
description: Mactwist to Tail Slide or Deep Stall directly connected into an Infinite Tumbling. The Tail Slide/Deep  Stall must not necessarily be long but shall be entered directly from the exit a mactwist

criterias.normal: Rhythm, flow, trajectory (no roll movement), tension in the lines and glider, duration, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: Twisted on the entry, untwist by the mac twist  and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling without twist
criterias.twisted exit: stay twisted during the exit of the Infinity Tumbling
criterias.full twisted: Twisted on the entry and stay twisted until the exit of the infinity tumbling
criterias.hardcore entry: Same as full twisted but with change of twist direction in the entry of the mac twist
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)

connection: Forbidden connection to Tumbling or Anti-Rhythmic SAT

name: Mac Twist
description: Spin from spiral maintained until pendulum stabilised

criterias.normal: energy and asymmetry on entry, speed and importance of rotation, pendulum stabilisation, fast exit or connection
criterias.twisted: must be twisted during the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the Mac Twist Twisted

name: Mac Twist to Helicopter
description: Mac Twist with the spiral maintained to Helicopter
minimum: same as Mac Twist and Helicopter

criterias.normal: flow and speed of transition
criterias.twisted: must be twisted during the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the Mac Twist
criterias.reverse: immediate transition to a Helicopter in the opposite direction

name: Mac Twist to Tumbling
description: 1 turn (360°) Mac Twist rotation (half a Mac Twist) followed by a high Tumbling

criterias.normal: energy on entry, timing, flow
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the glider
criterias.twisted exit: stay twisted during the exit of the Infinity Tumbling
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)

connection: Forbidden connection to Infinite Tumbling nor Anty-rhythmic

name: Misty Flip
description: Straight entry & climb, 360° spin, straight horizontal dive, exit not more than 180° from the direction of entry

criterias.normal: importance of pitch on entry, 360° rotation, maintenance of shape, strong dive, no rotation on entry and exit, direction
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the glider
criterias.twisted exit: the twist shall be kept for at least 3 seconds
criterias.full twisted: keep the twist during the whole manoeuvre from beginning till exit as well as during the whole rotation. No change of direction of the twist. Twist shall be kept for at least 3 seconds or until the next trick

name: MistyFly
description: Misty to Tail Slide or Deep Stall directly connected into an Infinite Tumbling. The Tail Slide/Deep  Stall must not necessarily be long but shall be entered directly from the exit a misty

criterias.normal: Rhythm, flow, trajectory (no roll movement), tension in the lines and glider, duration, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: Twisted on the entry, untwist by the misty  and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling without twist
criterias.twisted exit: stay twisted during the exit of the Infinity Tumbling
criterias.full twisted: Twisted on the entry and stay twisted until the exit of the infinity tumbling
criterias.hardcore entry: Same as full twisted but with change of twist direction in the entry of the misty
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)

connection: Forbidden connection to Tumbling or Anti-Rhythmic SAT

name: Misty to Helicopter
description: Misty Flip + transition to Helicopter

criterias.normal: flow and speed of transition
criterias.twisted: must be twisted during the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the Misty
criterias.reverse: immediate transition to a Helicopter in the opposite direction

connection: Forbidden connection to Helicopter

name: Misty to Misty
description: Misty chained with another misty on the other side using the exit energy of the first one

criterias.normal: same criteria as of Misty Flip
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the glider
criterias.twist_ext: the twist shall be kept for at least 3 seconds

name: Misty to SAT
description: Misty + transition to SAT

criterias.normal: same criteria as for Misty Flip and SAT + flow and speed of transition
criterias.twisted: must be twisted during the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the Misty flip
criterias.devil twist: twisted during the entry, untwisted by the spinning of the glider and twisted to the opposite direction, then connected to a twisted SAT. (FYI for this manoeuvre the pilot then has 3/4 twists during the SAT)
criterias.full twisted: must stay twisted during the rotation of the Misty Flip, keep the twist during the exit and stay twisted during the SAT until the exit
criterias.to_twisted_sat: Misty to Twisted SAT: normal (not twisted) Misty Flip, twisted during the end of the rotation of the misty connected into a twisted SAT

connection: Forbidden connection to SAT

name: Misty to Tumbling
description: Misty Flip (360° spin rotation) followed by a high Tumbling using the dive from the Misty Flip

criterias.normal: energy on entry, timing, flow
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the glider
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)

connection: Forbidden connection to Infinite Tumbling nor Anty-rhythmic

criterias.twisted: both pilots must stay twisted during at least 2 revolutions

name: Rodeo Helicopter
description: One pilot is performing a Helicopter while the other is spiralling around
minimum: 2 spiral revolutions around the helicopter at the same altitude

criterias.normal: same as for Helicopter
criterias.twisted: same as for Helicopter

name: Rodeo SAT
description: One pilot is performing a SAT while the other is spiralling around
minimum: 2 revolutions around the SAT at the same altitude

criterias.normal: same criteria of the SAT
criterias.twisted: same criteria of the SAT

name: Rythmic SAT
description: Entry without pitch, constant progression until reaching 180° + 1 straight rotation at the end

criterias.normal: rhythm and regularity of the variation of the axis, flow, angle, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, must stay twisted, untwist at the exit and NOT during the turns

connection: Forbidden connection to Tumbling, Infinite and Anti Rhythmic

name: SAT
description: Evenly balanced SAT rotation

criterias.normal: entry, angle of wing (90° for max score), low sink rate exit or connection (no collapse penalty for tip collapse during exit)
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, must stay twisted for 2 turns can be exited untwisted

connection: Forbidden connection to combo manoeuvres

name: SatFly
description: S.A.T to Tail Slide or Deep Stall directly connected into an Infinite Tumbling. The Tail Slide/Deep Stall must not necessarily be long but shall be entered directly from the exit a S.A.T. The S.A.T must be stalled “like” a S.A.T to Helico but instead of the Helico connected into a tail slide directly

criterias.normal: Rhythm, flow, trajectory (no roll movement), tension in the lines and glider, duration, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: Twisted on the entry, untwist during the transition to Tail Slide/Deep Stall  and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling without twist
criterias.twisted exit: stay twisted during the exit of the Infinity Tumbling
criterias.full twisted: Twisted on the entry and stay twisted until the exit of the infinity tumbling
criterias.hardcore entry: Same as full twisted but with change of twist during the entrance of the S.A.T. Be creative :)
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)

connection: Forbidden connection to Tumbling or Anti-Rhythmic SAT

name: SAT to Helicopter
description: Several SAT rotation + connection to helicopter

criterias.normal: flow and speed of transition
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, must be untwisted during the transition into helicopter, NOT before
criterias.reverse: immediate transition to a Helicopter in the opposite direction

connection: Forbidden connection to Helicopter

name: Stall
description: Straight climb + stall >90° for max score
minimum: 45° backwards pitch, over 90° for max score

criterias.normal: energy, importance of pitch, cleanness of the stall, control of direction and exit or connection
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, stay twisted when the glider stalls, untwist during the dive
criterias.twisted exit: the twist must be kept for at least 3 seconds or until the next manoeuvre
criterias.devil twist: twisted on the entry, untwist during the stall and immediately twist to the other direction, must exit twisted. The twist must be kept for at least 3 seconds or until the next manoeuvre
criterias.flip: body flip either forward or backwards during the stall. Flip may begin during the climb out and must be completed before the dive
criterias.flip_double: both flips must be chained, flow

name: Super Stall to Infinity Tumbling
description: Super Stall directly connected into an Infinite Tumbling. The Full Stall must not necessarily be high but shall be perfectly straight

criterias.normal: rhythm, flow, trajectory (no roll movement), tension in the lines and glider, duration, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, untwist after the stall and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling without twist
criterias.full twisted: twisted on the entry, stay twisted after the stall and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling twisted and untwist at exit (not during the turns)
criterias.devil twist stall: twisted on the entry, untwist during the stall and immediately twist to the other direction and proceed into the Infinity Tumbling twisted
criterias.twisted exit: stay twisted during the exit of the Infinity Tumbling
criterias.flip: the pilot performs a flip just after the glider stalled, proceed into the Infinity Tumbling
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)

connection: Forbidden connection to Tumbling or Anti-Rhythmic SAT

name: Synchro Asymmetric Spiral
minimum: Series of pendulum turns in the same time and direction during a synchro spiral, twice to the same side

name: Synchro Half Pipe Combo
description: Straight entry, minimum 45° climb before rotation & 180° spin, straight horizontal dive, exit 180° from the direction of entry, in transition use the exit energy of the first Half Pipe for the next one. Direction must be changed

criterias.normal: importance of pitch on entry, 180° rotation, maintenance of shape, strong dive, no rotation on entry and exit
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the glider
criterias.full twisted: keep the twist during the whole manoeuvre from beginning till exit as well as during the whole rotation. No change of direction of the twist. Twist shall be kept for at least 3 seconds or until the next trick

name: Synchro Spiral
minimum: 2 revolutions and a maximum distance of one paraglider line length between (approx. 10 metres)

criterias.wing touch: douhle or triple touche in one turn

name: Tail Slide
description: Stabilised backward flying with open glider

criterias.normal: maintenance of the shape, stability, perceptible backwards flight, control of direction, duration, exit or connection
criterias.twisted: twisted all the way from entry to exit

name: Tumbling
description: Asymmetric or inversion entry, perfect pitch movement

criterias.normal: energy on entry, timing, flow, trajectory (pitch movement), angle (180° for maximum score), exit or connection
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, must stay twisted, untwist at the exit NOT during the turns
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)
criterias.hardcore entry: twisted on the speed taking, getting untwisted and twisted in the other direction while pulling the entry
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn

connection: Forbidden connection to Infinite and Anti-Rythmic

name: Twister
description: Helicopter to one side, Heliptcopter to the other side

criterias.normal: speed of transition

connection: Forbidden connection to Helicopter

name: Wingovers
description: Series of pendulum turns with change of direction each time
minimum: twice to one side, twice to the other side, 135° angle

criterias.normal: rhythm, flow, trajectory, angle (minimum 135° for maximum score\ –\ the higher the better)
criterias.twisted: must be twisted during the entry, and stays twisted until the glider stabilises

name: Wingovers Cruzados
description: Same as Wingover Opposite but the pilots must cross each other during the manoeuvre

criterias.normal: same as Wingover Opposite

name: Wingovers Opposite
description: Series of pendulum turns with change of direction each time
minimum: twice to one side, twice to the other side with high angle (minimum 135°) the pilots perform the turns to the opposite direction of each other

criterias.normal: rhythm, flow, trajectory, angle (the higher the better)
criterias.twisted: must be twisted during the entry and stay twisted until the glider stabilises

name: X-Chopper
description: Entry with high energy, constant & rapid climb, spin, strong dive, exit
minimums: 90° climb, 360° spin dive not more than 270° from the direction of entry

criterias.normal: importance of pitch on entry, minimum 360° rotation, energy, maintenance of shape, strong dive
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the glider

name: X-Chopper to Infinity Tumbling
description: X-Chopper (Min 360° spin rotation) followed by a high Tumbling using the dive from the X- Chopper

criterias.normal: energy on entry, timing, flow, tumbling minimum 3 rotations. Perfectly straight axis on the first rotation of tumbling for max score
criterias.twisted: twisted on the entry, untwisted by the rotation of the glider
criterias.full twisted: twisted during the whole X-Chopper, staying twisted during the shoot and until the exit of the tumbling
criterias.hardcore entry: untwisted during the rotation of the X-Chopper immediately followed by a twist to the other direction, staying twisted during the shoot and until the exit of the tumbling
criterias.cab slide: get twisted during an infinity tumbling turn
criterias.devil twist: from a twisted situation, change of twist direction (within one turn)
